method.replays: Current profiles; saved root candidates and preceding checkpoints; one warmup then five repeats per mode, alternating order. Corrected replay rejects initialization failures and therefore can change simulation duration.
method.mcts: Fresh processes, seed 0, 64 iterations, current mcts_cuda.yml. Probe computes clearance but discards corrected poses; original trials retained to measure cost on the same workload. One baseline/probe pair per state, not a general latency guarantee.
method.initial_prototype: A 512-job clearance workspace for one candidate took 19.05 ms; fitting the workspace to the trial batch and skipping stone-pair detection on empty scenes removed most of that overhead.
method.geometry: Native DSF CUDA ground and nearby stone contact queries. Reupload, broad phase, gap/gradient lifting and recheck all timed. 10 um penetration tolerance; 0.1 mm target gap on lift, positive gradient >0.05, 5 cm per round, 25 cm total, 12 rounds. Non-upward contacts or invalid/unconverged queries are unresolved initialization, never counted as success.
